headline: Late Night Calls Lindsey Graham’s Senate Seat ‘an Inheritance Jackpot’
context: “A Senate seat? Most people just get a garage full of damp boxes,” Michael Kosta said of Graham’s sister filling the late senator’s seat on “The Daily Show.”
